## Citation

When using CDMetaPOP or cdmetapopR, please cite the relevant publications above and the software:

```bibtex
@software{cdmetapop_software,
  title={{CDMetaPOP}: an individual-based, eco-evolutionary model for spatially-explicit simulation of landscape demogenetics}
  author = {Landguth, Erin L. and Day, Casey C. and Bearlin, Andrew and Dunham, Jason and Simmons, Ryan K. and Forester, Brenna R. and Davenport, Kaeli and Seaborn, Travis}
  year={2025},
  version={3.0.8}
  url={https://github.com/ComputationalEcologyLab/CDMetaPOP},
  note = {Accessed: YYYY-MM-DD}
}

@software{cdmetapopr,
  title={cdmetapopR: A companion R package for the CDMetaPOP simulation software},
  author = {Alò, Dominique and Day, Casey C. and Williams, Allison and Roseman, Marissa and Landguth, Erin L.}
  year={2026},
  url={https://github.com/ComputationalEcologyLab/cdmetapopR}
}
```

## Related Software

Our has lab also developed other population genetics and landscape ecology tools:

- **CDPOP** - A spatially-explicit, individual-based population genetics program
- **UNICOR** - A program for estimating connectivity and resistance surfaces

Visit our [GitHub organization](https://github.com/ComputationalEcologyLab) for additional resources.

## Lab Information

**Computational Ecology Lab**

Our lab develops, optimizes, and applies individual-based simulation programs, spanning population genetics, disease ecology, and epidemiology, for understanding relationships between biological processes, environment, and climate with population patterns across landscapes. Our goals are to produce tools that will be valuable to natural resource managers, planners, decision makers, and scientists with a stake in maintaining biodiversity, from genes to ecosystems.

Website: [https://www.cellab.org/](https://www.cellab.org/)

## Contact

For questions about CDMetaPOP, cdmetapopR, or our other tools, please visit our [lab website](https://www.cellab.org/) or open an issue on GitHub.
